function.name: update_user_profile
function.description: Updates the user profile with the provided details. If certain details are not provided, existing information is retained. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user.

email.description: The updated email address for the user.

phone.description: The updated phone number for the user in E.164 format, such as '+1234567890'.

preferences.description: The updated preferences for the user. If not provided, the default preferences will be used.

newsletter_subscribed.description: Indicates if the user is subscribed to the newsletter.

birthdate.description: The updated birthdate of the user in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

message.content:
Hey there! I’m your friendly AI assistant, and I’ve got a whole toolbox of skills to help you out. Here’s a quick rundown of what I can do: | Category | What I can help with | |----------|----------------------| | **Information & Research** | • Answer questions on a wide range of topics (science, history, tech, pop culture, etc.)
• Summarize articles, reports, or long texts
• Provide quick facts, definitions, or explanations | | **Writing & Editing** | • Draft emails, letters, or professional messages
• Create blog posts, social media captions, or marketing copy
• Proofread and suggest edits for clarity, tone, and grammar | | **Learning & Study** | • Explain complex concepts in simple terms
• Generate study guides, flashcards, or practice quizzes
• Offer study strategies and time‑management tips | | **Creative Projects** | • Brainstorm ideas for stories, poems, or scripts
• Write short stories, poems, or dialogues
• Help with character development or plot twists | | **Technical Help** | • Explain code snippets or programming concepts
• Offer debugging suggestions (in a general sense)
• Discuss best practices for software design | | **Planning & Organization** | • Create to‑do lists, schedules, or project plans
• Suggest productivity tools and techniques
• Help set goals and track progress | | **Personal Development** | • Offer motivation and self‑care tips
• Discuss habits, mindset, and growth strategies
• Provide resources for learning new skills | | **Fun & Entertainment** | • Tell jokes, riddles, or trivia
• Recommend books, movies, or music based on your interests
• Play text‑based games or quizzes | If you have a specific task in mind—whether it’s drafting a professional email, brainstorming a creative idea, or just looking for a quick fact—just let me know! I’ll tailor my response to fit your needs.
message.reasoning: User asks "Hi, what can you do?" They want a general description of capabilities. We can respond with a summary.
